purpose: Prepare controlled release-edge branches under the user's revised plan; preserve the completed original chain.
unit_of_experiment: A declared previous published model, its updated model, and the same next-day requests for native/Rebuild/Reuse.

fixed.model: Max 16 layers, width 320, 10 heads, approximately 1.154B parameters
fixed.population: Original fixed 30000 training users, including short histories
fixed.primary_metric: request-macro observed-positive NDCG@10 over complete logged candidates
fixed.loss: observed BCE + 0.1 * complete-candidate multi-positive listwise cross entropy
fixed.next_day_evaluation: All eligible requests of the fixed cohort; no result-dependent window or candidate filtering
fixed.aggregate: Report every edge and both the equal-edge mean relative loss and pooled request metric; never silently average only positive edges
fixed.uncertainty: Paired UID-cluster intervals; existing edgewise 95% intervals are nominal, not simultaneous confidence statements

desired_workload.clear_positive_edges: Approximately half of a declared set, or several explicitly selected mechanism cases
desired_workload.interpretation: Desired workload characteristics, not guarantees or reasons to discard or clip an outcome

branch_recipe.first_pass: Reuse the exact original one-epoch endpoint and its AdamW state as the first-pass intermediate checkpoint
branch_recipe.second_pass: One further complete pass over exactly the original update day's training request list
branch_recipe.learning_rate_proposal: Repeat the original one-pass warmup/cosine schedule for pass two; peak 1e-4, warmup 5%, floor 5e-6
branch_recipe.shuffle: Deterministic second-epoch shuffle declared before fitting; do not repeatedly change seeds until a desired cache gap appears
branch_recipe.scope_of_claim: A second-pass optimization-budget experiment, including the declared learning-rate restart; not a pure epoch-count comparison under an unchanged global cosine horizon
branch_recipe.optimizer: Preserve model parameters and all original AdamW moments and step counters
branch_recipe.checkpoint_selection: Fixed second-pass endpoint in the pilot; any later epoch selection uses prerelease native validation, not the next-day Rebuild-Reuse gap
branch_recipe.lineage: Store previous_published_checkpoint, first_pass_checkpoint, and optimization_resume_checkpoint separately; preserve truthful optimizer ancestry
branch_recipe.implementation: Use a new isolated extension runner and release-edge evaluator. Do not change frozen original sources, parent-check guards, plans or results. Verify the original ancestry before accepting a published parent different from the immediate optimizer checkpoint.

initial_development_batch.reason: Positive-gap control for the same extra-pass recipe

interpretation_rules: Original M4->M5 and original M4->M5_e2 are a matched-parent branch comparison.
Original M5->M6_e2 is valid independently, but M5_e2->M6_e2 is not an actual continuous lineage.
A continuous new chain from M5_e2 requires training its own descendants.
Branches selected after observing the original gaps are development experiments, not fresh independent confirmation.
Report original and new native quality, Rebuild/Reuse gaps, uncertainty, training budget and all adverse results.
A larger gap alone does not establish better training or stability; inspect native held-out quality and repeat the fixed recipe across edges or seeds.
If this batch does not help, diagnose before adding more epochs or seeds; do not silently replace failed branches.

runtime_estimate.resource_basis: Four A40 GPUs, as in the completed original run
runtime_estimate.note: Projection from the original measured workload; verify throughput and device availability before launch

secondary_directions_not_queued.name: Two-day publication cadence using existing checkpoints
secondary_directions_not_queued.scope: Five published models and four edges; intervening daily training checkpoints remain real optimizer ancestors but are not published in this scenario
secondary_directions_not_queued.purpose: Separate cache producer age/publication cadence from extra optimizer work

secondary_directions_not_queued.name: Persistent causal cache replay
secondary_directions_not_queued.scope: Initialize at release, compare full rebuild at release with inherited cache, append only observed feedback causally, use identical FIFO retention and candidate read rules, record row producers
secondary_directions_not_queued.note: Current matched-prefix snapshots do not already implement this; FIFO may reduce rather than enlarge the gap

secondary_directions_not_queued.name: Fresh-data window versus repeated passes
secondary_directions_not_queued.scope: Compare a recent two-day window once against a recent one-day window twice at a common cutoff, from a common earlier parent and on the same next-day evaluation; record actual request and step counts

before_any_gpu_launch: Bind exact checkpoint paths, source/config/data hashes, published-parent ancestry and immutable output directories
Verify exact saved model/optimizer restoration and second-pass request coverage
Verify same-version Rebuild/Reuse identity and parity with original scores on a small fixed request set
Confirm current GPU allocation and measured memory headroom
Freeze the development recipe and preserve all branches and original results
